precision_definition.game-point: A verified point within play or review of the source game; not a game-start marker.
precision_definition.episode-window: Episode context inferred from the archive window; no timestamp or verified appearance is claimed.

method: Storyboard positions supplied candidates. Full-resolution frames were then inspected for the opponent/game identity. One opening candidate for game 86 was rejected as the preceding game and replaced with a verified later frame. Video frames and raw captions are retained as local working evidence, not redistributed.

games.verification: Sampled video point checked against the displayed opponent and source-game board sequence; historical handle changes were corroborated using the score and position.
